how: Build Phase 0 (the capabilities) with the shell, then the phases in order, each screen after the screens it depends on. get_build_roadmap(screen_id=...) shows one screen's dependencies with their evidence; get_screen_bundle(screen_id) has everything to build it.

phase_0_capabilities.what: One WebSocket per window, resume_from, de-duplication, Live / Reconnecting (guide realtime)
The patient banner: identifiers and flags, refreshed by patient.merged and death.recorded
One Idempotency-Key per user action, reused on retries (guide idempotency-and-concurrency)
expected_version on edits, the VERSION_CONFLICT dialog (guide idempotency-and-concurrency)
Frozen records awaiting approval, unfrozen by approval.resolved
Print payloads by printer role, A4 from fields, PDFs (guide printing-and-hardware)
PDF and file downloads; sets of documents by the pdf_download preference, never a ZIP
Keyboard-wedge scanner input routed to the screen's scan fields (guide printing-and-hardware)
multipart/form-data uploads (scans of signed forms, documents)

F1 and a visible Help button open this screen's handbook page (English and Urdu), also from a field or a dialog, keeping unsaved input; only the pages GET /meta/handbook lists (guide end-user-handbook)
Ctrl/Cmd +, - and 0 and the Settings slider move one zoom state clamped to 100-250 %, saved as ui_scale_pct (guides ui-quality Q4 and electron-integration)

phases.title: Shell
phases.goal: Every demo account can connect, log in, land, switch workspaces, see notifications, approve, report an incident, change settings and open help; the admin sets up the establishment's profile and services (nothing clinical starts on a new installation before that).
exit_criteria: Each demo account logs in and lands in its workspace; demo.owner sees the launcher with two workspaces.
A forced password change works (PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED).
The licence and maintenance banners appear and clear (system.license, system.maintenance).
session.revoked returns every window to the login screen.
Help opens with only the pages GET /meta/handbook lists for the user, and F1 opens the current screen's page from anywhere, inside a field or a dialog too.
Ctrl/Cmd plus, minus and zero and the Settings slider zoom between 100 and 250 percent, one state, restored after logging in again.
An approver sees and decides a pending approval (scenario opd.refund_pending_approval).

The admin previews and applies a change of profile or services; on establishment.changed every window redraws its launcher and menus from GET /establishment views (a clinic sees no ward, theatre or ER workspace; a retired service's screens become records) and hides the new work of a service that is not Active (CAPABILITY_INACTIVE never reaches a user).

phases.title: Outpatient front desk and consultation
phases.goal: The OPD revenue loop: open the shift, find or register, pay, queue; the doctor sees the patient live, writes a coded note and prescribes.
exit_criteria: demo.reception opens a shift, registers a new patient with cash and the slip prints (scenarios cash.shift_open, opd.new_patient_paid).
demo.doctor's queue updates without polling; the doctor calls the patient, finalises a note with an ICD code, prescribes and orders a test.

The discount ceiling, refund → approval → cash-back, deferral and version-conflict states work (scenarios opd.discount_over_ceiling, opd.refund_pending_approval, opd.ticket_deferred, patient.version_conflict).

phases.title: Pharmacy and diagnostics
phases.goal: The prescription reaches the pharmacy and is dispensed; tests are ordered, sampled, resulted, verified and published; critical results are told.
exit_criteria: demo.pharmacist dispenses a prescription (FEFO, a partial dispense, a high-alert second check) and prints the labels.
demo.labtech scans a sample and submits a result; demo.labverifier publishes it.
A critical value opens a critical result that is told, read back and acknowledged.
Imaging is ordered, performed and reported.

phases.title: Inpatient journey
phases.goal: Admit, allocate a bed, consent, estimate, nurse (roster, vitals, the MAR with the bedside checks), move, discharge.
exit_criteria: A doctor requests an admission (scenario ipd.admission_pending); admissions allocates a bed, prints the wristband, records the general consent and explains the estimate.
The nurse sees the bed on My beds, records vitals and gives a high-alert dose with a wristband scan and a second checker.
The patient moves to another ward (estimate prompt) and is discharged through every stage in order.

phases.title: Emergency, deaths and medico-legal cases
phases.goal: Triage by the hospital's scale, the ER board, Code Red end to end, the trauma identity merge, medico-legal cases, death and the body's release.
exit_criteria: A Code Red interrupts the destination, pharmacy and OT terminals and a retried press admits nobody twice (scenario er.code_red_incoming).
The temporary trauma profile is merged into the permanent record later (scenario patient.trauma_unmerged).
An ER visit is triaged by the hospital's scale and the board shows the waits.
A medico-legal case is opened; a death is recorded and certified, and the body handed over.

phases.title: Theatre and sterile supply
phases.goal: From the OT request to settlement, with the safety checklist, anaesthesia, recovery and traceable sterile packs.
exit_criteria: A load is sterilised and released, and its packs issued.
An operation is scheduled, assessed, consented, signed in, timed out and signed out; consumables and packs are scanned.
The anaesthesia record, the operative note and the recovery discharge are completed; the settlement is finalised.

phases.title: Finance, billing and back offices
phases.goal: Reconciliation, prices and panels, the pharmacy and laboratory back office, the owner's view.
exit_criteria: A shift is reconciled and a payable settled.
A price change shows at registration.
A batch is received and a recall run.
The owner's figures reflect the day's work.

phases.title: People, facility and IT
phases.goal: Onboarding to provisioning, badges and ID cards, rosters and attendance, leave, payroll, self-service, facility operations, the badge kiosk, maintenance.
exit_criteria: A new employee is onboarded, provisioned and badged.
A roster with a duty swap is planned.
Attendance flags appear and a leave request is approved; payroll is generated.
A badge scan at the kiosk cleans a bed; a work order is created and completed.

phases.title: Patient-safety programme
phases.goal: Complaints and incidents from every desk to closure, investigations, the action register.
exit_criteria: A complaint is recorded at reception, acknowledged, resolved, appealed and decided.
An incident is reported, reviewed, analysed and closed with an action.

phases.title: Records and clinical statistics
phases.goal: The consent register, record reviews, the deaths and medico-legal registers, ICD statistics, ER, diagnostics, medication, estimate and surgical statistics.
exit_criteria: A review cycle is planned, sampled, reviewed and reported, its deficiencies closed.
Every statistics screen shows the demo data the earlier phases recorded.

phases.title: Infection control, people quality and facility compliance
phases.goal: Infection surveillance and rates, quality indicators and benchmarks, committees, personnel files, appraisals, compliance and drills.
exit_criteria: An infection case is confirmed; wound surveillance runs; an audit is recorded.
Committee minutes are approved; a personnel file reaches complete.

phases.title: PHC inspection
phases.goal: The category, readiness, the inspection pack, the CPSA documents, the inspector's read-only login and the staff's preparation for the surveyors' questions.
exit_criteria: The category is confirmed and the PHC number appears on printouts.
Readiness is shown; the pack downloads as separate PDFs or one combined PDF by the user's preference, never a ZIP.
demo.inspector sees only the read-only documents.
A member of staff practises the questions of their role; a supervisor records a mock interview.

go_live_note: Configuration screens a real hospital needs before its first patient; the demo seed fills their data during development.
